recipes.name: Sukuma Wiki
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53113. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat the 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet or pot over medium heat until shimmering. Add the onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5 to 7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add the shredded kale to the onions and mix well. Turn the heat to medium-low, cover and cook for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: After 5 minutes, remove the lid, add salt to taste, and stir in the cream. Continue cooking for another 5 minutes, uncovered, stirring occasionally. The cream will thicken slightly, making for a deliciously rich creamed kale and onions. Yumm!

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Serve it up with your favorite Kenyan stew, and a side of ugali!
